description: Sergio Gor assured full cooperation to further expand Telangana-America relations across all sectors.
body_lead: New Delhi [India], August 6 (ANI): Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy held a meeting with US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor in New Delhi, in which they discussed the issue of visas along with several matters related to strengthening America-Telangana relations Chief Minister highlighted that Telugu is one of the fastest-growing languages in America as per a statement by the Telangana Chief Minister's Office (CMO). Sergio Gor assured full cooperation to further expand Telangana-America relations across all sectors.
